mods.name: Crafting Macro
mods.description: Client-side macro manager: bind keys to commands, automatic crafting and custom action sequences, all configured in-game.

releases.notes:
Beta for **Minecraft 26.3** (Fabric). Download `craftingmacro-1.4.0.jar` below and put it in `.minecraft/mods` (needs Fabric API).

## New in 1.4.0
- **Automation rules:** while a macro runs, the mod watches for a condition and handles it, then goes back to what it was doing.
  - Conditions: **every X seconds**, **held item durability at or below N uses**, **inventory full**, **N+ items on the ground** nearby
  - Response: pause the current action, run a command (for example `/fix`), wait, then **continue**, **restart from step 1**, or **stop**
  - Set them up under Edit > Options > **Automation rules** (up to 5 per macro)
- **New look:** all menu text now uses the Inter typeface instead of the Minecraft pixel font, and the icons come from Lucide.

## Notes
- Many servers forbid automated mining/AFK farming. Check the rules before using this on a server.
- Emergency stop: **End**.

releases.notes:
Beta for **Minecraft 26.3** (Fabric). Download `craftingmacro-1.3.0.jar` below and put it in `.minecraft/mods` (needs Fabric API).

## New in 1.3.0
- **World action steps:** Walk, Look, Left/Right click (tap or hold), Hold item (wildcards like `*_shovel`), Mine blocks (finds nearby blocks, looks at them, mines them, can walk to them)
- **Shovel Snow** preset: press **N** to toggle. It holds your shovel and mines all snow nearby.
- Violet/pink theme with glow and animated switches
- Fixed step editor text overlap

## Notes
- Mining and clicking need the game window focused with no menu open.
- Walking goes in a straight line (no pathfinding); blocks it can't reach are skipped.
- Many servers forbid automated mining/AFK farming. Check the rules before using world actions on a server.
- Emergency stop: **End**.

mods.name: Crafting Macro
mods.description: Client-side macro manager: bind keys to commands, automatic crafting and custom action sequences, all configured in-game.

releases.notes:
Beta release for **Minecraft 26.3** (Fabric).

## Install
1. Install Fabric Loader (0.18+) for Minecraft 26.3 and Fabric API.
2. Download `craftingmacro-1.2.0.jar` below and put it in `.minecraft/mods`.
3. In-game, press **Right Shift** to open the macro manager.

## Features
- Command, auto-craft and sequence macros on any key (Ctrl/Shift/Alt supported)
- Click / Hold / Toggle trigger modes
- Works inside an open crafting table
- Custom pattern designer for custom server recipes
- Animated +N crafted feed and a Stats screen
- Profiles with import/export

## Beta notes
Tested: builds, 66 unit tests pass, loads in the 26.3 client. In-world and multiplayer crafting still need more testing. Please report bugs in Issues.
